title: SchemaDefinition
description: Definition of a business schema/dataset. Backed by a PocketBase collection and stored in schema_definitions.

schema_id.description: Unique identifier for this schema (e.g. inventory, orders, customers).

name.description: Human-readable display name (e.g. คลังสินค้า, Customer Directory).

description.description: Optional description of what this dataset is for.

icon.description: Optional icon identifier or emoji for navigation tabs.

can_create.description: True if PocketBase createRule is enabled for API.

can_update.description: True if PocketBase updateRule is enabled for API.

can_delete.description: True if PocketBase deleteRule is enabled for API.

options.description: Allowed values for select field types.

target.description: Target schema_id for relation field types.

system.description: True for system-generated fields (id, created, updated).
